record_type: Collection of published Hugging Face model release scope records
scope_note: Each nested scope retains its original repository, artifact identifiers and prospective designation. Relative artifact paths inside each scope refer to that Hugging Face repository, not this GitHub repository. This collection does not designate framework code under the model license or change any original designation date.
